definitions.explanation: A count of three people, using the Sino-Japanese number with the counter for people.

examples.japanese: {三人|さんにん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: The three of us will go.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{三人|さんにん}⟦います→いる：00495_iru⟧。
{三人|さんにん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{学生|がくせい}→学生：00610_gakusei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{答|こた}えた→答える：01099_kotaeru⟧。

notes:
{三人|さんにん} uses the Sino-Japanese number ⟦{三|さん}→三：00749_san⟧ with the counter ⟦{人|にん}→〜人：00658_nin⟧ for people.

COUNTING PEOPLE:
The readings for one and two people are irregular: ⟦{一人|ひとり}→一人：00630_hitori⟧, ⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧. From three onward, the regular Sino-Japanese system is used: {三人|さんにん}, ⟦{四人|よにん}→四人：30566_yonin⟧, ⟦{五人|ごにん}→五人：30567_gonin⟧.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {三人|さんにん}で: as a group of three
- {三人|さんにん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧: all three people
- {三人|さんにん}⟦{兄弟|きょうだい}→兄弟：00964_kyoudai⟧: three siblings
- {三人|さんにん}{組|ぐみ}: a trio, group of three
- {三人|さんにん}⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧: three servings (food)

CULTURAL NOTE:
The expression {三人|さんにん}⟦{寄|よ}れば→寄る：02440_yoru⟧{文殊|もんじゅ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{知恵|ちえ}→知恵：03428_chie⟧ ("three heads are better than one") is a well-known proverb.
